papers.title: KVStream: Adaptive Parallel Storage Management for KV Caching in Large-Scale LLM Serving

papers.title: HAWK: Heterogeneity-Aware KV Cache Transfer for Efficient GPU-NPU Phase-Disaggregated LLM Inference

papers.abstract: Speculative decoding is a technique that accelerates the inference speed of autoregressive large language models (LLMs) by sampling from a faster, lower quality draft model. papers.title: BeNice! Closing Looping's Inference-Memory Gap via KV-Sharing
papers.abstract: Looped architectures scale quality while keeping parameter count fixed by repeatedly passing activations through the same block of layers.
